_doc: Strategy registry (v101). Every live sleeve: hypothesis, validation evidence, expected live bands, decay/retire rules, revalidation schedule. The weekly reconciliation routine reads this and runs backtests/decay_check.py. Nothing is overwritten - edit via PR only. Numbers carry the survivorship haircut caveat (backtests/README S7).

expected.notes: Modeled stack ~Sharpe 1.9 hindsight / ~1.2-1.4 survivorship-adjusted; alert if trailing-6m realized Sharpe < 0.3 or DD exceeds -12% (vol-targeting should prevent). 2026-08-17: live gross must be reconciled vs modeled deployment weekly — 42% vs 95% cap ran undetected Jun-Aug 2026.

book_level.retire_if: n/a - book level; escalate to full revalidation instead

multi_tf_rsi.hypothesis: Pullbacks within confirmed uptrends (RSI40>52, price>EMA50, RSI10 turning up from 38-56) resolve upward within days.
multi_tf_rsi.evidence: scorecard.py 2015-2026: 3587 trades, 43% win, +0.36%/trade, PF 1.23, monthly Sharpe 0.97 (best sleeve).
multi_tf_rsi.retire_if: 60+ live trades with expectancy < 0 OR win rate < 0.30

mean_reversion_rsi2.hypothesis: Sharp oversold snaps (RSI2<10) above the 200DMA revert to the 5DMA within days (Connors).
mean_reversion_rsi2.retire_if: 60+ live trades with win rate < 0.50 OR expectancy < -0.1%

donchian_trend.hypothesis: Multi-week breakouts to 40d highs on liquid large-caps persist; exit on 20d-low break. Low win rate, fat right tail.
donchian_trend.evidence: donchian_validate/expand: sleeve Sharpe 1.39, PF ~2, +2.3%/trade, subs [1.42/1.31/1.61]. v101.4: unvalidated chop/transition regime gate removed (donchian_gate_test: gate costs Sharpe 1.28->1.05); stack refresh through 2026-08-14 12m-Sharpe 1.56. v101.5: bear gate + regime-flip sweep removed (donchian_bear_gate: gated Sh 0.94 vs 1.29, worse DD) — sleeve now fully gateless, matching validation.
donchian_trend.retire_if: 40+ live trades with PF < 1.0; do NOT retire on win rate (structurally ~39%)

crypto_trend.hypothesis: BTC/ETH/SOL trend-persist above their 200DMA; being flat below avoids crypto winters. Value = 0.03 corr to equity book, not the CAGR.
crypto_trend.evidence: crypto_sleeve/x5: +10-15% sleeve lifts book Sharpe 1.33->1.6+; 2022 exit worked. CAVEAT: asset-class inclusion is hindsight-selected; sized small deliberately.

expected_live.behavior: flat when coins < 200DMA (correct all July 2026); entries only above

crypto_trend.retire_if: trend gate demonstrably fails twice: >15% sleeve DD while gate said long in a sustained downtrend

gold_trend.hypothesis: GLD above its 200DMA earns; 0.02 correlation to book makes even Sharpe 0.61 additive at 10%.
gold_trend.evidence: x5_sleeves grid: +10% gold lifts book Sharpe 1.70->1.81, improves 2022 flip.

expected_live.behavior: single position, trend-gated; overlap-guarded vs dual_momentum GLD

gold_trend.retire_if: 12mo live with negative contribution AND corr to book > 0.3

quality_momentum.evidence: exp +0.04%/trade, PF 1.03, ~baseline. Kept: low turnover (33 trades/yr), harvests beta.

dual_momentum.evidence: Own Sharpe 0.86 < SPY; +0.02 book Sharpe at 10%. Ceiling right-sized to 0.25.
dual_momentum.retire_if: revalidation shows book contribution < 0 two quarters running

spy_dip.evidence: validate_small_sleeves: +0.78%/tr vs +1.56% random-entry control — dip filter destroys value on index ETFs.

sector_rotation.evidence: validate_small_sleeves: rotation Sharpe 0.82 < equal-weight sectors 0.87 — selection adds nothing.

conviction_long.evidence: Fundamental scanner; not price-backtestable free. Judged on live fills only. v101.5: ceiling 0.60->0.25 pending fill review.

short_hedge_vix_reversal.evidence: Defensive plumbing, sized small; judged on regime behavior not expectancy.

breakout,52wh_vol,momentum,trend_pullbac.evidence: Entries worse than random baseline (vs_base -0.09..-0.13); ~750 trades/yr friction. Exits still managed.

gap_scanner,mean_reversion_rsi14,cs_mome.evidence: See backtests/README - no edge / unvalidatable / negative.

earnings_drift,earnings_prediction,ai_re.evidence: Small/external-data sleeves, never individually validated. Candidates for the next cull if live fills underperform.

ts_momentum.evidence: validate_small_sleeves: Sharpe 0.77, corr(engine) 0.76 — diluted beta, fails diversifier bar.
